fields.label: Background Overlay Color
fields.name: background_overlay_color
fields.instructions: NOTE: This color layer is not affected by the Background Blend Mode!

fields.label: Background Desktop Video
fields.name: background_desktop_video
fields.instructions: This video should be in an MP4 format and a size no larger than 20MB.

fields.label: Background Desktop Video (WebM)
fields.name: background_desktop_video_webm
fields.instructions: This video should be in an WebM format for Chromium powered browsers and a size no larger than 20MB.

fields.label: Background Mobile Video
fields.name: background_mobile_video
fields.instructions: This video should be in an MP4 format and a size no larger than 10MB.

fields.label: Background Mobile Video (WebM)
fields.name: background_mobile_video_webm
fields.instructions: This video should be in an WebM format for Chromium powered browsers and a size no larger than 10MB.

fields.label: Fixed Width
fields.name: fixed_width
fields.instructions: Changes the hero width from full to the site's max width (located in Site Options).
